title: 讓表達更有條理(連接語)

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: First of all, learning English opens doors to jobs.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: In addition, it lets you travel more easily.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: For example, you can ask for directions or order food anywhere.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: However, it takes time and practice.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: To sum up, it's difficult but worth it.
